beats.care: Heading home after garba tonight or tomorrow? Catch the metro by 12:30 am instead of a costly late cab.
beats.what: MMRDA's metro operator added 53 late trips: 10 on Line 2A, 15 on 2B, 14 each on Lines 7 and 9.
beats.why: Navratri events run late, and the metro wants to clear late-night crowds safely.

cards.body: Spread across Lines 2A, 2B, 7 and 9, at about 15-minute gaps.
cards.caption: extra late-night trips

cards.q: Why extend metro hours this week?
cards.why: The extension is for Navratri, when many people travel home late.

cards.q: How do you get home after garba?

cards.body: The extension started on October 16 and ends on October 20.

hook: Can you take the *metro home after garba*?

learn.t: Usually the last metro on these lines leaves around 11 pm; for Navratri it's 12:30 am.

sources.name: Free Press Journal
sources.title: Mumbai Metro Extends Navratri Services Till 12.30 AM From October 16–20 On Lines 2A, 2B, 7 & 9

sources.name: Nativeplanet
sources.title: Mumbai Metro to extend its operations until 12:30 a.m. until 20 October

tldr: Metro Lines 2A, 2B, 7 and 9 run until 12:30 am through October 20 for Navratri, with 53 extra trips.
watch: October 20 is the last night of extended metro hours.
